text:
Type: tall wood-framed wall mirror
Use: checking an outfit, reflecting light; hallway, bedroom, bathroom, living room
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: painted wood frame in a matte finish, bevelled mirror glass
Colors: black-brown, silver reflective glass
Shape: tall narrow rectangle, flat frame topped by a projecting crown cornice and resting on a stepped plinth base, slim side rails, upright and stately, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, formal, timeless, calm
Goes with: white or grey walls, dark wood, brass or chrome accents, crisp linens; classic, traditional or farmhouse rooms
